description: TaskManager is supposed to allow at most ONE task to be RUNNING at a time -- starting or resuming a task while another is already running should raise a ValueError, not silently allow two tasks to run simultaneously. Right now TaskManager.start_task and TaskManager.resume_task don't check this, so a specific sequence of start/pause/resume calls across multiple tasks can leave more than one task RUNNING at once. Fix the state management bug in task_manager.py (task_state.py's Task class itself is correct).
constraints: do not remove the ability to pause a running task and later resume a different one
